svg.title: Selin Vashti Corr, Whisper-Broker of the Glass Spires

text.tspan: Selin Vashti Corr, Whisper-Broker of the Glass Spires
Fast. When this resolves, look at an opponent's Hand; then
Selin Vashti Corr trades in The Panoptic Concord's oldest
currency: things people would rather she didn't know.
